impacts.reason: Impact is the price manipulation window created by sequencer downtime; the L2/centralized-sequencer deployment, downtime, frozen timestamp, and restart-backlog preconditions directly establish that window, and both intents explicitly require validating/handling sequencer uptime so snapshots are not recorded from stale timestamps.

Corruption of oracle data arises from snapshots recorded with stale timestamps; the L2/downtime/frozen-timestamp/backlog preconditions directly support that, and both intents explicitly require validating sequencer status and handling downtime before recording snapshots.

Exploitation of dependent protocols follows from corrupted oracle snapshots; the same L2/downtime/stale-timestamp preconditions apply, and both intents explicitly require sequencer uptime validation/handling to prevent stale-timestamp snapshots.

Losses from liquidations/trades based on corrupted prices depend on the same L2 downtime and stale-timestamp snapshot conditions, and both intents explicitly require validating/handling sequencer uptime so corrupted prices are not produced.
